title: The old county inside modern Shenzhen
summary: Behind Nantou’s south gate is a chapter of Shenzhen history written long before the city’s modern skyline. A Ming coastal garrison was established here in 1394. In 1573 the town became the seat of Xin’an County, which once included territory now in Hong Kong. The gate gives you a way into that older geography from a street in present-day Shenzhen.

sections.heading: Look for the stone above the arch
sections.text: Shenzhen’s Nanshan district identifies the south gate as retaining its original appearance. Above the arch, a rectangular stone bears the characters 宁南 in seal script. Look up from the approach to spot the inscription and see how the narrow opening contrasts with the streets beyond.
